text:
liz: Heads up — finalizing pricing page experiments: new calculator, tier-name A/B test, FAQ updates. Need a short launch plan (post + webinar) and inbound routing rules. Want to announce beta calc + webinar next Wed. Thoughts?
raj: Love it. One ask — include a concise benchmark narrative (cost per 1k tokens vs common configs). Can we get numbers by EOD so marketing has a headline stat?
olivia: Product can supply a few perf points (avg latency, tokens/sec, and relative cost on our Dedicated vs hosted). I’ll paste a tiny table later.
sam_analytics: I’ll run a funnel sim for calculator -> signup -> webinar. Also will add an event: pricing_calc_submit and the standard utm dimensions.
emma_sales: For inbound routing: want to flag "hot" leads (>=3 calc runs + webinar sign-up) to AE queue immediately. Can we make that rule?
liz: @emma_yes — routing is doable. @raj can you draft the rule? Prefer something we can wire to Intercom/HubSpot webhook.
raj: Proposed copy for tier name A/B test: Variant A = Starter / Team / Scale. Variant B = Starter / Growth / Enterprise. We should test both in the calc flow and the pricing page hero.
olivia: I slightly prefer "Team" because it maps to our org buyers, but OK to test. Keep sample features consistent across variants so the only signal is the name.
liz: FAQ updates — add an entry: "How is billing calculated (caching, batching, and per-token)?" Also add a short sample calculation for a 5k token prompt. @sam_analytics can you give a 2–3 line explainer?
sam_analytics: Draft FAQ copy: "Billing counts tokens processed (prompt + generated). Caching reduces billable tokens when identical prefixes match cached responses; batching aggregates requests but billing is still per-token, not per-request. Quantization doesn't change billable tokens, only compute cost." Will trim to 2 lines for the FAQ UI.
marketing-bot: Reminder: webinar page needs GA + gclid support and the webinar registration form must send utm_source. Creating tracking ticket #PRICING-324.
liz: Can someone draft the launch post (2 short paragraphs) — key lines: 'New pricing calculator to estimate real infra costs per feature; join our webinar for a live demo and benchmark walkthrough.' Keep it customer-focused and include one benchmark stat.
emma_sales: I’ll draft the post and share in #marketing-content by EOD. Also coordinating AE handoff playbook for hot leads.
raj: Draft routing pseudocode for ops review:
```
# pricing calc routing rules (pseudo)
if event == "pricing_calc_submit":
  if calc_runs >= 3 and webinar_signup == true:
    route = "ae_queue_high"
  elif calc_runs >= 1 and webinar_signup == true:
    route = "marketing_followup_webinar"
  elif calc_runs >= 1:
    route = "nurture_leads"
  else:
    route = "self_serve"
```
liz: Perfect. Timeline: final copy by Tue 4pm PT, analytics + routing tests Wed morning, webinar rehearsal Thu, launch post Wed EOD. Who owns verification of routing?
olivia: We’ll run a smoke test on staging for the webhook + Intercom mapping. I’ll validate mapping with sample payloads.
sam_analytics: I’ll produce the benchmark numbers and the event queries. Will post a small CSV with sample runs.
emma_sales: AE queue alerted and handoff doc template in progress. I’ll prototype the Slack-to-AE notification and sample qualification notes.
liz: Great — tagging: @sam_analytics @emma_sales @raj @marketing-bot. Ping here as drafts land. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
